PROPERTIES.player_hint_1_en: Only one square fits both parts of Gideon's clue ("He was beside a table in the Art Room."). So Gideon (G) must be at row 4, column 3. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_2_en: Look at Dexter: every square he could still use shares a row or column with row 1, column 7. So nobody else can stand at row 1, column 7, or Dexter would have nowhere to go. Celeste's clue ("Someone else in her area was sitting in a chair.") needs the person sitting in a chair in Celeste's area on a square that does not share her row or column; that rules out squares for Celeste. Elsa's clue ("Someone else in her area was beside a shelf.") needs the person beside a shelf in Elsa's area on a square that does not share her row or column; that rules out squares for Elsa. The same kind of reasoning rules out a few more squares. All of Angus's squares are in row 3, so nobody else can use it. So Dexter (D) must be at row 1, column 8. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_3_en: With the rows and columns of Gideon and Dexter crossed out, only one square is left for Elsa that fits her clue ("Someone else in her area was beside a shelf."). So Elsa (E) must be at row 2, column 6. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_4_en: Celeste's clue ("Someone else in her area was sitting in a chair.") needs the person sitting in a chair in Celeste's area on a square that does not share her row or column; that rules out squares for Celeste. All of Celeste's squares are in column 4, so nobody else can use it. All of Freya's squares are in column 7, so nobody else can use it. So Angus (A) must be at row 3, column 2. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_5_en: Using the general clue ("There was exactly one person beside a drum set."), some squares are ruled out for Freya. So Freya (F) must be at row 7, column 7. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_6_en: Celeste is now the only person who can still go in row 8. So Celeste (C) must be at row 8, column 4. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_7_en: The murderer must be in Valerie's area without sharing her row or column; that rules out squares for Valerie. So Valerie (the victim) must be at row 5, column 5. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_8_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Beatrix that fits her clue ("She was north of Freya."). So Beatrix (B) must be at row 6, column 1. Cross out her row and column. Elsa is the only person in the Classroom with Valerie, so Elsa is the murderer!
